WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
 

 
 

Within Nike's European Logistics Campus, supply chain is at the heart of the athlete and consumer experience
 

Our ambition is to accelerate service, efficiency and cost improvements by combining data-driven problem solving with end-to-end solution design.
 

Within our organization, there are different teams where you could bring your expertise, with a focus on areas such as transportation, planning and operations.
 

You will work closely with operational teams, analysts, specialists, managers, and internal and external partners across our logistics network. Together, we connect expertise across functions, distribution centers, channels and value streams to improve performance faster and at scale.
 

You will contribute to one strong team, focused on delivering for athletes and consumers while continuously raising the bar in logistics.
 

 
 

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
 

 
 
 

• Own and improve day-to-day performance: Monitor supply chain and logistics performance, identify deviations and translate insights into clear actions with the right owners and timing. 

• Turn data into decisions: Combine operational information and analytical insights to identify root causes, opportunities, risks and practical recommendations. 

• Automate day-to-day workflows: Identify repetitive, manual or fragmented activities and help redesign them into simpler, standardized and automated workflows. Partner with process owners and technology teams to define requirements, test solutions, support implementation and track adoption and value. 

• Drive continuous improvement: Structure and deliver improvement initiatives with clear scope, milestones, risks, expected outcomes and measurable business value. 

• Design end-to-end solutions: Work across functions, distribution centers, channels and value streams to connect local improvements to the wider logistics network. 

• Support implementation: Stay close to the operation from problem definition through testing, deployment, stabilization and handover. 

• Build scalable ways of working: Create clear processes, documentation, dashboards and routines that make improvements sustainable and reusable across teams. 

• Engage stakeholders: Facilitate discussions, align different perspectives and communicate progress, decisions and next steps clearly. 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

 
 
 

• ACT WITH URGENCYYou don’t wait for the perfect conditions. You step in, take ownership and stay close to the action. You turn insights into decisions and decisions into momentum. 

• LEAD WITH HOWHow you win matters. You bring analytical thinking and a problem-solving mindset, challenge the status quo and make the complex simple. You communicate with clarity, bring people along and build strong partnerships across the business. 

• BE FLEXIBLEThe game can change fast, and you’re ready to move with it. You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, navigate ambiguity with confidence and adapt as priorities shift. You’re curious to learn different parts of the supply chain and ready to contribute wherever you can create impact. 

• PLAY TO WINYou keep your eyes on the finish line. You focus on solutions that work, value that can be measured and improvements that make a real difference. You don’t stop at the idea. You help bring it to life.  

 
 

YOUR SPORTS BAG CONTAINS
 
 

• A bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent professional experience, in supply chain, logistics, engineering, business analytics or a related field. 

• You bring a strong interest in supply chain and have built relevant knowledge or hands-on experience through your education, internships, projects or professional experience in areas such as supply chain, distribution, logistics, project delivery or process improvement. 

• Strong project-management skills, with experience structuring work around clear deliverables, milestones, risks and expected outcomes. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data and operational information into clear insights and recommendations. 

• Experience identifying workflow improvement opportunities and translating business needs into standardized or automated processes. Experience with workflow, analytics or automation tools is an asset. 

• The ability to work independently while collaborating across teams, functions and organizational levels. 

• Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills. 

• Professional proficiency in English. Dutch is an asset. 

• Curiosity, adaptability and a willingness to learn new processes, technologies and areas of the supply chain. 

• Experience with analytics tools, Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, process mapping, simulation or supply chain technology is an asset.  

 
 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 
 

• Operational issues are translated into clear actions and sustainable improvements. 

• Manual day-to-day activities are simplified, standardized or automated where this adds value. 

• Projects deliver measurable service, cost, quality or productivity improvements. 

• Solutions are implemented successfully, adopted by the operation and scalable beyond one team or process. 

• Stakeholders understand the priorities, decisions, ownership and next steps.

Would you like to work for an international company where technology and healthcare come together?
 

As a Technical Support Officer, you will become part of a close-knit team, supporting customers with high-quality software solutions for the medical sector. You'll benefit from a comprehensive training programme and plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.
 

Your responsibilities as a Technical Support Officer:
 

As a Technical Support Officer, you are the first point of contact for customers who need technical assistance. You primarily support French-speaking customers, while also communicating regularly in English with colleagues and customers from other countries.
 
 
 
• Provide technical support to customers regarding software, hardware, and connectivity issues. 
 
• Assist customers via phone, email, and remote support, primarily in French. 
 
• Analyse technical issues and work together with customers to find the most suitable solution. 
 
• Guide customers through software installations, updates, and configurations. 
 
• Accurately register and follow up on support requests in the CRM system. 
 
• Escalate more complex issues to specialised colleagues when necessary. 
 
• Work closely with colleagues and other internal departments to resolve complex technical queries. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 
 
• You have initial experience in Technical Support, Customer Support, or an IT Help Desk role. 
 
• You have a strong interest in software, IT, and technology. 
 
• You are fluent in both French and English, both spoken and written, as you will use these languages daily when communicating with customers and colleagues. 
 
• You are solution-oriented and remain organised when dealing with multiple requests at the same time. 
 
• You are able to prioritise effectively and manage your workload efficiently. 
 
• A secondary education diploma (A2 level) is sufficient. Above all, we value your motivation, eagerness to learn, and passion for technology.

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of analog and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

Are you about to finish your degree with a thesis? Do you want to apply your software engineering skills to a real world product used in medical imaging?

We are offering a thesis position focused on modernizing a legacy software component and better integration into the existing quality assurance infrastructure.

During your project you will use C++, our internal development framework, AI-assisted development tools and modern continuous integration (CI) practices to migrate an existing code base to a new framework and establish a robust automated testing environment. You will collaborate closely with imaging specialists and development experts to ensure the software meets the high quality standards needed for medical applications.

Job Description

Are you about to finish your degree with a thesis? Do you want to apply your software engineering skills to a real world product used in medical imaging?

We are offering a thesis position focused on modernizing a legacy software component and better integration into the existing quality assurance infrastructure.

During your project you will use C++, our internal development framework, AI-assisted development tools and modern continuous integration (CI) practices to migrate an existing code base to a new framework and establish a robust automated testing environment. You will collaborate closely with imaging specialists and development experts to ensure the software meets the high quality standards needed for medical applications.

Your Role
 
• Design, implement, and improve automated unit and regression tests 
• Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate code migration, test generation, 
refactoring, and documentation
 
• Establish and monitor code coverage metrics 
• Integrate testing, coverage analysis, and regression checks into the existing CI/CD pipeline 
• Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize future software migration efforts 
• Use and improve best practices for integrating AI coding assistants into software modernization workflows 
• Collaborate with senior software developers and imaging experts to validate functionality and quality 
Your Profile
 
• Bachelor's or Master's student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 
• Strong affinity with software development, testing, automation and development infrastructure 
• Experience with C++ development, experience with other programming languages is a plus 
• Familiarity with git and CI/CD concepts is an asset 
• Curious and eager to explore new tools, technologies, and environments 
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English/Dutch and a collaborative mindset

EDR Antwerp Shipyard is the largest shipyard in Belgium, specialised in ship maintenance and repairs, hull treatment and marine construction. Challenging activities require skilful and motivated team members. Over 150 vessels annually are repaired and maintained at our shipyard in Antwerp, and projects are performed on board vessels across the world.
 

As a 
Crane Operator, you play a key role in ensuring safe, efficient and well organised lifting operations within and around our dry dock. You will primarily operate one of our 
five cranes and support a wide range of dockside activities that contribute directly to vessel repair and maintenance projects. You will join a close knit team of experienced crane operators where teamwork and safety are central.
 

RESPONSIBILITIES
 

• Operate one of the 
five cranes on site, including a Wolff tower crane, a Wolff luffing jib crane and three fully restored shipyard cranes with lifting capacities of up to 100 tonnes
 

• Carry out lifting operations safely and efficiently in accordance with site procedures and operational requirements
 

• Support signalling and guidance of lifting movements in areas with limited visibility or restricted access
 

• Assist with dry dock operations (such as the positioning of docking blocks)
 

• Actively support crane operations by maintaining clear lifting zones, monitoring traffic routes and minimising downtime
 

• Coordinate incoming materials and deliveries, ensuring safe and appropriate storage locations are assigned
 

• Serve as a communication link between subcontractors, shipyard teams, vessel crews and fellow crane operators
 

• Provide basic rigging support and assist colleagues in selecting and using suitable lifting equipment
 

• Maintain good order, cleanliness and safety standards around the dry dock area
 

• Identify, report and document damage, deviations and unsafe situations
 

• Support other operational activities on site when crane work is temporarily unavailable
 

 
 

#ontmoetingsdag

• Good knowledge of English, which is the primary language used for operational communication, radio contact and coordination with subcontractors and vessel crews
 

• Knowledge of Dutch is an advantage for internal coordination and site instructions. Knowledge of Polish and/or Romanian is considered a strong asset
 

• Strong safety awareness and the ability to maintain oversight and prioritise effectively in a dynamic work environment
 

• Confident communicator with a practical and collaborative approach
 

• Hands on attitude and a consistent commitment to agreed procedures and safety standards
 

• Experience with crane operations, forklifts and/or mobile elevated work platforms is highly advantageous
 

• Flexibility to align working hours (daytime hours) with operational requirements, deliveries and lifting schedules
 

• Weekend work may occur, but is not mandatory and will be arranged in consultation with the other colleagues

Own the roadmap of the registration platform behind one of the world’s largest top-level domains, from EPP to data analytics.

Product Owner – Registration Services

Our client is a European not-for-profit organisation, human-sized and firmly technology-driven, responsible for managing and operating one of the world’s largest country-code top-level domains in the public interest.

What makes it stand out? It delivers secure, resilient and accessible registration services to millions of users across Europe, through a network of accredited registrars.

The organisation is modernising its core registration platform and shaping the next generation of services supporting the registration and management of domain names.

To drive this, it is looking for a Product Owner to define the vision, roadmap and priorities across these mission-critical activities: core registration platform, EPP, registration APIs, domain-name lifecycle, registry-to-registrar integrations, data analytics and platform modernisation.

 

The job

• Based in Diegem and working within the Technology Department, you operate at the intersection of Business Operations, Architecture and Service Design, Engineering, Service Delivery, Compliance and Security.
• Translate strategic, operational, regulatory and stakeholder needs into clear product direction and deliverable priorities, balancing immediate service improvements with long-term modernisation, resilience, security and technological sovereignty.Role
• Define and maintain the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the assigned Registration Services areas: core registration platform, EPP, registration APIs, RDAP, domain-name lifecycle and data analytics capabilities.
• Own, structure and prioritise the backlog, making transparent trade-offs between business value, urgency, risk, delivery capacity, dependencies and long-term sustainability.
• Work closely with Business Owners and with the engineering, architecture, service delivery, compliance and security teams to ensure requirements are understood, feasible and aligned.
• Give clear product direction to the Business Analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Ensure compliance with GDPR, NIS2, AI regulations and internal governance frameworks, and monitor developments within ICANN, IETF, CENTR and the wider domain-name ecosystem.
Profile
• University degree in computer science, engineering, business, information systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• At least seven years in technology-driven products or services, including substantial experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager. Familiarity with the domain-name ecosystem, EPP, WHOIS or RDAP and DNS provisioning is a strong asset, as is a background in telecommunications or another regulated service industry.
• Excellent written and spoken English; knowledge of other European languages is an asset.

You will be in charge of your own section within the machinery department and will become the go-to specialist that everyone turns to when things get a bit more technically challenging.

• You’ll work with PLC systems, motors, sensors and variable speed drives.
• You read electrical diagrams and delve into technical drawings.

• You monitor maintenance and scheduled interventions and keep the technical documentation up to date.
You’re our ideal candidate if…

• You have a bachelor’s degree in electromechanics, with a focus on electrical engineering, or equivalent experience.
• You combine technical insight with a genuine ‘can-do’ attitude.
• You can analyse and resolve faults independently.
• You work accurately and always put safety first.
• You work well both independently and as part of a team.
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English.
Ready to put your technical skills into practice? Send us a message and find out if this job could be your next step!

Are you a passionate machine learning engineer with expertise in generative AI? Join our Machine Learning Enablers team at Proximus Ada, where you’ll play a key role in advancing and scaling generative AI capabilities across teams. You will leverage your expertise in architectures such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based systems to develop and maintain reusable components and templates that enable data scientists to deliver impactful solutions. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with data scientists in delivery teams and engineers from our Cloud and DevSecOps teams to implement best practices and ensure technical excellence across multiple projects. Using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph and our Azure-first stack, you will maintain and expand a shared repository of reusable generative AI assets that enable scalable, reliable solutions. 

Your innovative mindset will help identify emerging techniques and translate them into practical building blocks that deliver business value, keeping our teams aligned with the latest advances. Your work will support the day-to-day needs of our data scientists through the practical maintenance, hands-on support, and enhancement of shared assets, while also driving innovation in our generative AI initiatives. 

Responsibilities 

Develop and Maintain our Generative AI Repository 

• Manage and expand our shared repository of reusable Generative AI components and templates, ensuring it is robust, up-to-date, well-documented, and easy to adopt across use cases. 
• Support onboarding and adoption: help teams use the repository effectively, keep alignment with the main branch, and facilitate clean integration of shared changes. 
• Collaborate with data scientists to identify new components to build, provide technical support, and promote best practices in using the repository. 
• Drive key upgrades and migrations of core libraries and templates (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph) with minimal disruption to delivery teams. 
Enable Agent-Based and Generative AI Solutions 

• Guide delivery teams on architectures such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based systems, providing hands-on technical support and troubleshooting when needed. 
• Research and prototype emerging techniques, frameworks, and Azure services; translate validated approaches into reusable building blocks for delivery teams. 
Collaborate and Drive Technical Excellence 

• Define and promote software engineering best practices for Generative AI solutions (testing, code quality, style, automation) and enforce them through PR reviews and shared standards. 
• Collaborate with Cloud, DevSecOps, enterprise architecture, and vendors to ensure solutions and technologies align with our stack and constraints.
• Stay current with advances in Generative AI and communicate relevant learnings and recommendations to the organization. 
 

Profile

Education 

• Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. 
• A Ph.D. is a plus, especially with research in Generative AI or agent-based systems. 
Professional Experience 

• Minimum of 2+ years of relevant experience in a business environment in AI/ML engineering or software engineering.
• Proven experience working with generative AI models and LLMs in real-world projects. 
• Demonstrated ability to build reusable components and templates, and transition proof-of-concepts into production-ready assets. 
• Experience collaborating with delivery teams and stakeholders, providing technical guidance and support. 
Technical Skills 

• Strong coding skills in Python, with solid software engineering best practices (testing, code quality, documentation, maintainable design). 
• Proficiency with version control (Git) and modern development workflows, including CI/CD pipelines. 
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and relevant Azure Data & AI services. 
• Experience with Generative AI frameworks such as LangChain; familiarity with LangGraph is a plus. 
• Experience implementing MLOps best practices (e.g., experiment tracking with MLflow). 
• Familiarity with monitoring and evaluation practices for Generative AI applications. 
Soft Skills 

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail.
• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, provide actionable guidance, and produce high-quality documentation. 
• Collaboration and enablement mindset: comfortable supporting and mentoring others through code reviews and hands-on troubleshooting. 
• Ownership and autonomy: able to prioritize effectively and drive work to completion in a transversal context. 
• Curiosity and innovation mindset: proactive in exploring new techniques and translating them into practical improvements. 
Languages 

• Fluent in English and preferably also French and/or Dutch.

About you

As a Group Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA) Audit & Certification Assistant, you will provide administrative, analytical, and reporting support for food safety audits and certification programs across our international production sites.
